lines:
flowchart TD
    A[User or Codex requests QA run] --> B[Resolve job ids or query filters]
    B --> C[Create qa_runs execution group]
    C --> D[For each enabled matching QA job]
    D --> E[Snapshot command and metadata]
    E --> F[Execute command with timeout]
    F --> G[Capture output and exit code]
    G --> H[Store qa_job_runs evidence]
    H --> I{More jobs?}
    I -->|yes| D
    I -->|no| J[Summarize qa_runs result]
    J --> K[Bump project revision]
    K --> L[Dashboard and MCP read derived states]
